title: Welcome to GrantScout Pro
content: GrantScout Pro is an AI-powered grant discovery, intelligence, and application platform.
It helps individuals and organizations find grants, evaluate eligibility, generate narratives, and manage applications.
This manual provides guidance for using all major features of the platform.

title: Searching for Grants
content: Use the Search page to find grants by keyword, category, agency, funding type, or filters.
Filters include deadline, amount range, location, industry, eligibility, and grant source.
Search results include AI-enhanced summaries, eligibility indicators, and competitiveness scores.
You can save searches for later and receive updates when new grants match your criteria.

title: Grant Intelligence Overview
content: Grant Intelligence provides unified AI analysis for each grant.
Scores include eligibility, risk, competitiveness, readiness, and alignment.
AI summaries explain the grant in plain language.
AI recommendations provide actionable steps to improve your chances.
Historical intelligence is stored for each grant, including rewrites, narratives, forecasts, and reviewer insights.

title: Grant Pages
content: Each grant has a dedicated page showing metadata, deadlines, funding amounts, eligibility, and agency details.
AI-generated sections outline the structure of the grant.
Narratives, rewrites, proposals, and AI logs are displayed for deeper insight.
You can save grants to your workspace for tracking and collaboration.

title: Workspaces
content: Workspaces allow teams to collaborate on grants, documents, and applications.
Members can view, edit, and run AI tools depending on their permissions.
Workspaces include shared documents, files, insights, notifications, and analytics.
Each workspace has its own grants, applications, and intelligence history.

title: Workspace Members & Roles
content: Owners manage workspace settings, billing, and member access.
Members can collaborate on grants, documents, and applications.
Invited users receive email notifications and can join via secure links.
Roles determine access to AI tools, editing permissions, and grant visibility.

title: Applications & Narratives
content: Applications include narratives, drafts, versions, and submission history.
AI tools can rewrite, critique, expand, or optimize narrative content.
Each application stores multiple versions for tracking changes over time.
Submission history includes timestamps, statuses, and reviewer notes.

title: AI Tools
content: AI tools assist with rewriting, summarizing, analyzing, and generating grant content.
Tools include narrative rewriting, eligibility analysis, risk scoring, competitiveness scoring, and proposal generation.
AI logs track all actions performed by the system for transparency.
AI usage is monitored per workspace for billing and analytics.

title: Documents & Files
content: Documents support collaborative editing, versioning, snapshots, and semantic search.
Files include uploads such as PDFs, Word documents, and supporting materials.
Embeddings allow semantic search across documents and files.
Document access controls determine who can view, edit, or run AI tools.

title: Notifications
content: Notifications alert users about grant updates, workspace activity, AI actions, and deadlines.
Workspace notifications include shared insights, reports, and member activity.
Users can mark notifications as read or clear them from their dashboard.

title: Insights & Comparisons
content: Insights provide AI-generated analysis across multiple grants.
Comparisons allow users to evaluate grants side-by-side.
Comparison activities and comments help teams collaborate on decisions.
Insights include scoring, recommendations, and strategic guidance.

title: Billing & Subscription
content: Workspaces have subscription tiers such as Basic, Team, and Enterprise.
Billing includes AI usage, member seats, uploads, and addon features.
Trial periods allow users to explore features before subscribing.
Stripe integration handles payments, renewals, and invoices.

title: User Profile
content: Users can update their organization details, mission, website, and focus areas.
Profile information helps personalize grant recommendations.
Past grants, wins, and losses improve AI scoring accuracy.

title: Grant History Tracking
content: GrantScout Pro tracks dozens of history types including narratives, rewrites, forecasts, reviewer insights, compliance, and more.
Each history entry includes timestamps, user IDs, workspace IDs, and grant IDs.
History is used to improve AI recommendations and provide audit trails.

title: Security & Access Control
content: GrantScout Pro uses role-based access control for documents, grants, and AI tools.
Users can only view or edit items they have permission for.
AI actions are logged for transparency and auditing.
All data is stored securely using encrypted connections.

title: Support
content: For help, use the AI Help Assistant or contact support through your workspace.
You can ask questions about features, grants, applications, or AI tools.
The help system uses this manual to provide accurate answers.
